description: Verify whether a single email address is real and safe to send to, in real time. Returns a deliverability verdict (deliverable | undeliverable | risky | unknown), a 0–100 confidence score, a safeToSend flag, and signals (catch-all, disposable, role-based, free provider, likely typo). Spends 1 verification credit per call. Tip: addresses at the test.verifyany.email domain (e.g. deliverable@test.verifyany.email, undeliverable@…, risky@…, unknown@…) return canned results and cost 0 credits.

catchAllDetection.description: Set false to skip catch-all detection. Default true.

email.description: The email address to verify, e.g. name@example.com

smtpProbe.description: Set false to skip the live SMTP mailbox probe (DNS-only). Default true.

name: verify_email
